Subject: Shared Playbook: Eval Sprint, Benchmarks, and Prompt Stewards

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the productive demo yesterday. Per our conversation I sketched a one-page mutual action plan (attached) to accelerate a two-week POC focused on retrieval-augmented generation for your support knowledge base. High-level asks:

- Confirm success criteria (what wins the pilot for CareLogic).
- Share a primary technical contact + procurement contact (if different).
- Approve the proposed schedule so we can reserve dedicated infra.

Attachment: CLG_MAP_v1.xlsx (lightweight MAP with milestones and owners).

Proposed success criteria (suggestions):
- Response accuracy: >= 85% on a blinded 200-query benchmark
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for single-turn queries
- Cost: projected inferencing cost within agreed budget (we'll share estimates once we see token profile)

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm internal owners by EOD Tue (who owns QA/prompts, who signs for procurement).
2) We schedule a short kickoff Wed where product, Marissa (benchmarks), Ben (prompt library) and Priyom (deployment) are present.

I copied Marissa and Ben to pick owners and initial test plan items.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference

Confirmed success criteria from CareLogic leadership:
- Usability: support agents rate answers >= 4/5 on relevance in a blind review of 150 queries
- Safety: no PII leakage; we will run a random sample and require redaction checks
- Throughput: ability to sustain 25 concurrent agent sessions without degradation

Stakeholders:
- Sara Jenkins — Project lead / Product (me)
- Tom Alvarez — Procurement (included)
- Adam Rhee <adam.rhee@carelogic.ai> — Data & Analytics (will join the kickoff)

We can do the Wed kickoff — morning Pacific works. Can you include the MAP and a short playbook for what Marissa's benchmark will look like? I've attached carelogic-security-questionnaire.pdf — procurement will review in parallel.

Looping in details on the benchmark plan. High-level approach below — will provide the scoring script and seed dataset before kickoff.

Benchmark plan (Marissa)
- Test set: 200 queries sampled from CareLogic staging logs (we'll mutually agree on sampling strata)
- Ground truth: agent-verified relevance labels; CareLogic will provide annotation guidelines and 25 gold examples
- Metrics: Top-level relevance (4/5+), top-1 accuracy for retrieval, hallucination rate (manually audited subset), latency percentiles (p50/p95) measured from Redwood's dedicated pool
- Scoring cadence: initial baseline within 48 hours of data receipt; final run after prompt tuning and one model variant change

Deliverables by role:
- Redwood (Marissa): scoring script, initial baseline report, final benchmark report with comparisons to baseline
- Redwood (Ben): initial prompt set (5 intents x 3 variations), prompt-doc with expected behaviors
- CareLogic: sanitized staging logs, one SME for annotation (2-4 hours)

I'll attach a small checklist and a bash script to run the scoring locally. See attached link in the MAP sheet.

Marissa Cole
Lead Applied ML | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Thanks team — I'll own the prompt library. Quick plan:
- Deliverables: prompt-doc (markdown), initial 15 prompts covering top support intents, 3 variations per prompt for A/B testing
- Tuning cadence: we'll ship the initial set within 48 hours of receiving the 200-query sample; iterate after the first baseline
- Guardrails: include explicit PII redaction instructions in prompts; flag outputs that contain entity patterns for a manual review queue

I'll also prepare a small measure-of-change worksheet for the A/B runs so we can quantify improvements per prompt variant.
